renderings.value: Expresses various items or actions, 'things like..., and so on'.

「～やら～やら」 is used to list multiple things or actions in a somewhat non-exhaustive way. It can be translated as 'things like A and B' or 'A, B, and so on.' The grammar is often Verb-casual + やら, Noun + やら, い-Adjective + やら, etc.
Verb-casual + やら, い-Adjective + やら, な-Adjective + やら, Noun + やら
やら～やら: this and that, with a sense of chaos (宿題やら掃除やら).
I have lots of things to do, like homework and cleaning.
I bought all sorts of foods, such as vegetables and fruits.
She’s really talented—she can sing well, dance, and so on.
The store has all kinds of items like bags, shoes, accessories, etc.
